$comment: PRIVACY: This message must never contain raw identifying user data.
title: History Payload

days.description: The number of summary rows this payload carries (protocol 33). Until protocol 33 it was the number of days requested, which the cloud does not honour: it answers at most 7.

source.description: Where the summaries were built (protocol 33). cloud: synced daily summaries, UTC calendar days. this_mac: built on this Mac from its own retained events, per local calendar day, when the account is signed out or the cloud could not answer; nothing is stored and nothing leaves the Mac, and focus_score, fragmentation_score and the baseline are null or unavailable.

longest_uninterrupted_seconds.description: Longest broad-lane stretch of the day. The cloud API calls it focus_seconds; Rust renames it when it parses the API response and has sent this name over the socket since the field was added (2026-07-18). Until 2026-09-25 this schema and the Swift decoder used focus_seconds, so Swift read 0.
